ipa.financial_contracts.cds.ProtectionLegDefinition

API endpoint for Financial Contract analytics, that returns calculations relevant to each contract type.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.cds.ProtectionLegDefinition.

Syntax

ProtectionLegDefinition(
    *,
    direction: Direction | str = None,
    notional_ccy: str | None = None,
    notional_amount: float | None = None,
    doc_clause: DocClause | str = None,
    seniority: Seniority | str = None,
    index_factor: float | None = None,
    index_series: int | None = None,
    recovery_rate: float | None = None,
    recovery_rate_percent: float | None = None,
    reference_entity: str | None = None,
    settlement_convention: str | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
direction Direction | str No None The direction of the leg. Optional for a single leg instrument (like a bond), in that case default value is Received. It is mandatory for a multi-instrument leg instrument (like Swap or CDS leg).
notional_ccy str | None No None The ISO code of the notional currency. Mandatory if instrument code or instrument style has not been defined. In case an instrument code/style has been defined, value may comes from the reference data.
notional_amount float | None No None The notional amount of the leg at the period start date. Optional. By default 1,000,000 is used.
doc_clause DocClause | str No None The restructuring clause or credit event for Single Name Cds. Optional. By default the doc_clause of the reference_entity's Primary Ric is used.
seniority Seniority | str No None The order of repayment in the case of a credit event for Single Name Cds. Optional. By default the seniority of the reference_entity's Primary Ric is used.
index_factor float | None No None The factor that is applied to the notional in case a credit event happens in one of the constituents of the Cds Index. Optional. By default no factor (1) applies.
index_series int | None No None The series of the Cds Index. Optional. By default the series of the BenchmarkRic is used.
recovery_rate float | None No None The percentage of recovery in case of a credit event. Optional. By default the recovery_rate of the Cds built from reference_entity, seniority, doc_clause and notional_currency is used.
recovery_rate_percent float | None No None The percentage of recovery in case of a credit event. Optional. By default the recovery_rate of the Cds built from reference_entity, seniority, doc_clause and notional_currency is used.
reference_entity str | None No None The identifier of the reference entity, it can be:
- for Single Name : a RedCode, an OrgId, a reference entity's RIC,
- for Index : a RedCode, a ShortName, a CommonName. Mandatory.
settlement_convention str | None No None The cashSettlementRule of the CDS. Optional. By default "3WD" (3 week days) is used.
